description.p: QtParted is a graphical partition editor based on libparted. It shows the partitions of every disk, lets you queue changes and applies them in one go, with a detailed log of every step.

ul.li: Create msdos (MBR), GPT and the other partition tables supported by libparted
Create, delete and format partitions, with MiB or cylinder alignment
Over 20 file systems: ext2/3/4, btrfs, xfs, f2fs, fat16/32, exfat, ntfs, swap, LVM2 PV and more
Resize, move, copy and paste partitions, also growing mounted file systems online
Check and repair file systems, set labels and new UUIDs
Open, close and resize LUKS encrypted partitions
Mount and unmount, swapon and swapoff, activate LVM Volume Groups
Set partition flags and GPT partition names
Pending operations can be undone before anything is written

screenshot.caption: Partitions of a disk with two pending operations
Applying operations with a detailed log

description.p: Repaired application icons; German, French, Portuguese and Brazilian Portuguese translations.
Rewrite for Qt 6 with a new core modelled on GParted 1.8.

ul.li: Partition tables, create, delete, format, flags and GPT names
Resize, move, copy and paste, also growing mounted file systems online
Check, label and new UUID for 21 file systems
LUKS open, close and resize; mount, swap and LVM Volume Group actions
Italian translation and a built-in user manual
